scope: Pre-review criteria for one-page Babel Planning comparison

source.book: 巴别塔之后 语言及翻译面面观
source.source_visual_review: Bilingual dramatic dialogue plus Chinese discussion of historical/contextual meaning; source includes English lexical examples.

criteria: Plan stays within uploaded single page and uses excerpt physical page 1 for anchors.
Activity durations explicitly allocated should total at most the requested 30 minutes; omission of durations is reported separately.
Main learning problem should include context and historical/cultural change in interpretation, not solely literal dialogue translation.
Examples must occur on this page; unsupported play title, author attribution or external chapters are flagged.
Rigorous persona should emphasize quote/context/evidence checks; explorer should emphasize comparison, alternative interpretations and discussion.
Image usefulness is judged against actual received image counts and saved plan content, not enabled capabilities.
limitations: Four cells with one sample each are exploratory, not a stable causal effect estimate.
Native page injection is experimental, distinct from production tool retrieval.
OCR is a lossy Latin vocabulary extraction of a bilingual page.
Neither rendering nor nonempty OCR certifies accurate reading.
